peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Higher relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Higher relative price than most peers: 27.3% above its local comparables; 132 of 144 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Around peers (67.8): 3.7 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 272 of 405 similar developments with a figure (the same as 5). Context, not scored: resales in 75% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 2-bedroom: median $2,850,000 ($2,730 psf, 1,044 sq ft; 5 resales, Mar 2024–Feb 2026); 7 comparable developments within 3 km: median $2,188 psf (range $2,018–2,565); 24.8% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $566,000 more. 3-bedroom: median $5,975,000 ($2,818 psf, 2,109–2,131 sq ft; 8 resales, Jul 2024–Jun 2026); 8 comparable developments within 3 km: median $2,171 psf (range $2,000–2,366); 29.8% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $1,372,000 more. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Holland Village MRT about 660 m, Farrer Road MRT about 780 m; closer than 79 of 551 similar developments (the same as 4). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 0 within 1 km and 4 within 2 km; nearest Nanyang Primary School about 1,050 m; more than 0 of 551 similar developments (the same as 106). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 2 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 550 m), more than 34 of 551 similar developments (the same as 38); nearest hawker centre Empress Road Market And Food Centre about 540 m; nearest park Sbg Lc Zone 1 (Tnc) about 830 m. Straight-line distances.

nearestHawker.name: Empress Road Market And Food Centre

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 4 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Skye at Holland, 666 new sales, about 990 m; Blossoms by the Park, 11 new sales, about 1,710 m; The Hill @One-North, 14 new sales, about 1,740 m; Watten House, 12 new sales, about 1,940 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 101 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 703 new sales and 338 resales (1,041 purchases); new sales were 67.5% of these purchases. Subsales (22) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: No site within 2 km in the known list. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Quiet area: local resales are among the lowest 30% of similar developments, so little nearby competition reflects a thin market, not an advantage. 338 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 36 of 551 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 338 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 366 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−7.7%). Planning-area private resales −4.6%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
